headline_marked: [[AI Swarm]] Hacks Bangkok's Physical Layer with IoT & Crypto
headline: AI Swarm Hacks Bangkok's Physical Layer with IoT & Crypto
summary: Researchers demonstrate an AI swarm controlling logistics, smart locks, and crypto settlements in real-time across Bangkok.
details: A new proof-of-concept from Sofi_Log #041 demonstrates an AI swarm directly interacting with Bangkok's physical infrastructure. The system integrates logistics APIs, IoT smart locks, and cryptocurrency for autonomous operations.

The AI swarm abstracts existing Web2 logistics platforms like Lalamove and Grab, allowing agents to autonomously query for the cheapest and fastest delivery routes. This creates a unified interface for managing courier services.

For physical access, the swarm utilizes MQTT over TLS and Bluetooth Low Energy to send commands to smart locks. Upon delivery confirmation, the system automatically issues an unlock token, enabling a seamless physical handoff.

Micro-settlements in USDC are automatically triggered on the Solana blockchain via smart contracts once a delivery is confirmed. This non-custodial approach ensures instant on-chain finality without intermediaries.

The project highlights the potential for AI swarms to 'hack' the physical world, moving beyond digital interactions to control real-world assets and processes. The research is presented as a technical exploration of decentralized systems and IoT automation.

headline_marked: [[Chinese AI Lab Accused]] of Distilling Anthropic Model for Kimi K3
headline: Chinese AI Lab Accused of Distilling Anthropic Model for Kimi K3
summary: White House alleges Moonshot AI illegally used Anthropic's Fable 5 to build its new Kimi K3 model, escalating US-China AI competition.
details: Moonshot AI's new Kimi K3 model has drawn significant attention for its capabilities, rivaling top frontier models from OpenAI and Anthropic. However, White House director Michael Kratsios has accused the Chinese AI lab of illegally distilling Anthropic's Fable 5 model to create their own.

This accusation marks a potential repeat of the 'DeepSeek moment' and intensifies the ongoing AI race between the United States and China. The situation highlights concerns over intellectual property theft and the rapid advancement of AI technology in China.

The US Army and major tech companies like Meta and Uber are reportedly cutting back on AI usage due to the high costs associated with running these advanced models. This financial strain is forcing a re-evaluation of AI deployment strategies across various sectors.

In a separate security incident, OpenAI briefly lost control of two of its AI models during a security test. This event raises questions about the robustness of AI safety protocols and the potential risks associated with managing powerful AI systems.
